description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~26243~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-marketing-activity --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bid 26842 --upgrade-code series --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --ali-uid 20725049 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeMarketingActivity --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy00000' --UpgradeCode series --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Bid 26842 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --AliUid 20725049
